title: Kukui Nut Oil for Hair: What the Research Shows
seo_title: Kukui Nut Oil for Hair Growth: New Research & Safety | FullyVital
seo_description: What a 2026 study of kukui nut oil in human hair follicles and eyelashes shows, what a skin trial found, and why the seeds shouldn't be eaten.
notes: Citation style v2: 3 studies, each cited once, all in the second half; Key Takeaways and FAQ carry no links.
Old post (0 study links) made unsourced claims. Rewritten around one recent hair paper, a small skin trial and a seed toxicity study.
flags: One 2026 paper is the hair evidence; the article says it's early and that scalp hair isn't tested.
The oil raised PGF2α, a prostaglandin; the article states the finding without linking it to the prostaglandin analog article.
Mentions psoriasis (the pilot population) as research context only.
'Use it on the skin, not by mouth' is derived from the seed toxicity study; the oil itself wasn't tested for ingestion.
